title: New World on manifest schema 2: Type voice, Motion and Images dials and four Looks reach the site

source.ref: Finish every theme overnight (Daniel 2026-11-04 07:14Z): New World fully plugged into the theme builder

detail: lib/themes/editor-schema2.json gains a new-world entry (manifest id and site id are both new-world): register (Night), corners, spacing, header, footer, type (caps), motion (full) and image (glow), with the Studio, Nightline, Paper and Trade Looks from the New World theme editor handoff (record.js LOOKS; hero dropped because it is fixed, header centered dropped because no renderer draws it yet). Hero and accent are fixed: the hero's variant lives on the block and the accent has the theme's own picker. The generated manifest becomes schema 2. servicesDials is generalised as siteRootDials (servicesDials stays as its alias); the New World skin carries it in site-page (published site and coming-soon) and the editor canvas, so the root writes data-type, data-motion and data-image. A new sheet, components/sites/new-world-dials-css.ts, is laid after NEW_WORLD_CSS wherever the New World skin is drawn, scoped under [data-house-theme="new-world"]. What each dial does on New World: Type voice caps is the theme's own uppercase display; editorial puts Instrument Serif upright in the lead with the display face as a small capitals phrase (handoff base.css; the upright cut is added to NEW_WORLD_FONT_CLASS); quiet is the block sheet's sentence-case voice. Images glow is the theme's own; mono greys photos and the photo hero; grain lays the noise over photos and the photo hero; clean removes grain, which New World only draws when grain is picked, so clean draws like glow. Motion full is the theme's own; calm slows the drifting glow to 44s and stills the pulsing dot; off stops the glow, the ticker, the dot and the header loop; prefers-reduced-motion still stops everything. Corners re-point New World's radius tokens (subtle 8/10/16, square 0), so cards and photos follow; spacing balanced and compact set the section rhythm from the handoff (compact also narrows the gutter); header pill and bar and footer full and minimal already drew through the shared look sheet and chrome. Nightline equals the theme's own values, so it draws like Theme's own. Guarded by components/sites/new-world-dials.render.test.tsx; renders of each Look at 1440 and 390 from scripts/render/new-world-looks.render.tsx.
